title: Welcome to the FIKRADO Community!
excerpt: Join our growing community of cybersecurity enthusiasts, students, and professionals across the Horn of Africa.
content:
Welcome to the FIKRADO Security community page! This is where we share updates, insights, and resources from our Facebook community at Stratosphere Aeronautics.

Our community brings together:
- Cybersecurity students and professionals
- Technology enthusiasts from Somaliland and Ethiopia
- AI and machine learning learners
- Ethical hacking practitioners
- Linux and networking students

Follow our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/Stratosphere1/ for daily updates, live sessions, and community discussions.

title: Free Cybersecurity Training Cohort in Hargeisa - Applications Open!
excerpt: Applications are now open for our next free 12-week cybersecurity training cohort in Hargeisa.
content:
FIKRADO Security is excited to announce our next free cybersecurity training cohort in Hargeisa, Somaliland!

This 12-week program covers:
- Network fundamentals and protocols
- Linux administration and security
- Introduction to ethical hacking
- Practical hands-on labs

The program is delivered in Somali and English, and every participant finishes with a practical portfolio. As a 50% non-profit, this cohort is completely free for selected students.

Limited seats available. Apply through our contact page mentioning 'Hargeisa Cohort 2026'.

title: Hands-On AI Workshop Completed in Jijiga
excerpt: Participants built complete AI projects from data collection to working demos in our two-day workshop.
content:
Our two-day applied AI workshop in Jijiga, Ethiopia wrapped up with fantastic results!

Every participant shipped a working demo. The workshop was structured around building rather than lectures:
- Day 1: Data collection, preprocessing, and model training
- Day 2: Evaluation, deployment basics, and project presentations

Key insight from participants: the biggest constraint wasn't compute power — it was knowing how to frame problems that models can actually solve.

We're planning a follow-up session focused on evaluation and deployment. Stay tuned for announcements!

title: New Video Series: Linux Fundamentals for Cybersecurity
excerpt: Starting this week: a complete video series on Linux from basics to advanced security topics.
content:
We're launching a new free video series on our YouTube channel covering Linux fundamentals for cybersecurity professionals.

Series outline:
1. Linux file system and permissions
2. User and group management
3. Network configuration and troubleshooting
4. Service management with systemd
5. Shell scripting for automation
6. Security hardening basics
7. Log analysis and monitoring
8. Container basics with Docker

New episodes every Tuesday and Thursday. Subscribe to our channel to follow along!

title: OSCP Preparation Study Group Forming
excerpt: Weekly study sessions for those preparing for the OSCP certification. Starting next Monday.
content:
We're forming a study group for OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) preparation!

Details:
- Weekly virtual sessions (Mondays, 7 PM EAT)
- Covers: enumeration, exploitation, privilege escalation, post-exploitation
- Practice labs on Hack The Box and TryHackMe
- Mock exam simulations
- Led by our OSCP-certified team members

Open to anyone with basic networking and Linux knowledge. Register interest via our contact page.

title: Mobile Security Awareness Campaign Launched
excerpt: New campaign to educate users on SIM swap protection, mobile malware, and secure messaging.
content:
With mobile money being the primary payment method across the Horn of Africa, mobile security is more critical than ever.

We're launching a community awareness campaign covering:
- SIM swap attack prevention
- Detecting mobile malware and spyware
- Secure messaging practices
- Protecting 2FA codes
- Safe app installation

Free resources and infographics available in Somali, Amharic, and English. Share with your networks!

title: Women in Cybersecurity Mentorship Program
excerpt: New mentorship program connecting experienced professionals with women entering the field.
content:
We're proud to announce our Women in Cybersecurity mentorship program!

This program pairs experienced female cybersecurity professionals with women students and early-career professionals across Somaliland and Ethiopia.

What's included:
- Monthly one-on-one mentoring sessions
- Career guidance and resume reviews
- Technical skill development
- Network access to industry professionals
- Support for certification preparation

Applications open until October 31st. Limited mentor spots available.

title: Community Meetup in Addis Ababa - November 15th
excerpt: In-person community meetup for cybersecurity professionals and students in Addis Ababa.
content:
Save the date! Our next community meetup is happening in Addis Ababa.

Date: November 15, 2026
Time: 2:00 PM - 6:00 PM EAT
Location: To be announced (central Addis Ababa)

Agenda:
- Lightning talks (10 min each)
- Networking sessions
- Live demo: AI-powered threat detection
- Career panel with industry professionals
- Free pizza and networking

Free entry. Registration required - limited to 100 attendees. Register via our contact page.
